The cube_3-to-cube_2 face-alignment axis constraints were removed because the runtime rejects any mix of `freeze_orientation` with other orientation constraints in one stage; the fixed fingertip orientation is the more direct requirement for this release controller stage. Unrepresented clauses: exact symmetric finger-joint value 1.0, finger effort drop, negative grasp state, no-contact constraints, continuous monitoring requirements, cube_3 positional support/lateral alignment on cube_2, cube_2 positional stability on cube_1, and cube face alignment cannot all be encoded here with the available positive-only operators, the single-position-op rule, and the runtime prohibition against mixing `freeze_orientation` with other orientation constraints.
